decisions.executionNote: Begin left-side doll approach, raising and pitching gripper down gradually in elbow-up configuration. Plan dolls in central blue, pens red, bracelets white.
Align left gripper above the outer-left doll's torso, completing downward pitch while advancing slowly.
Descend around doll torso, close, then make a small test lift; retention will be checked visually.
Doll appears retained at its lower body; lift clear and carry toward left half of blue basket. Right arm starts a separate approach to rightmost doll.
Left doll fell back to table; reapproach inner-left doll with deeper torso grasp rather than assuming retention. Complete right downward alignment, keeping arms separated.
Use wrist view to center left fingers on narrow torso, close and test lift. Lower right open gripper toward its doll without closing yet.
Left contact appears at feet rather than torso; reopen and advance onto torso with deeper placement. Center and close right gripper on torso, then start a very small lift.
Both dolls now occupy the finger gap at torso height. Maintain closed commands and lift vertically to verify retention before transfer.
Right doll remains clearly retained; carry high toward blue basket. Left doll slipped, so reopen and rotate closing direction across its now-horizontal torso before retrying.
Continue retained right doll toward right half of blue basket. Lower left open gripper with closing direction now perpendicular to doll body, observing alignment before closing.
Replan after continuity stop: lower and tilt right wrist slightly forward to reduce reach while bringing doll over blue basket. Continue left descent slowly.
Shift left grasp onto torso using rotated wrist view, close and test lift. Place retained right doll well inside blue basket, open, and withdraw a little.
First doll is released in blue. Lift left doll with closed gripper and verify retention; right withdraws to approach the black pen, pitching fully downward.
Left doll is retained through lift; carry toward left half of blue while easing wrist yaw. Right aligns its closing direction across black pen and approaches from above.
Bring retained left doll over blue with its length across the basket, tilting forward to reduce reach. Descend right to black pen barrel and close without lifting yet.
At continuity boundary, stop advancing left; release doll already over blue and retreat inward from extended posture. Hold right closed at pen, then test lift slowly.
Two dolls are in blue. Carry retained black pen toward red; left returns above remaining doll and aligns the closing direction across its torso.
Release black pen within red basket and retreat. Lower left toward remaining doll's torso, correcting small tilt and image offset before grasp.
Center left pads across remaining doll torso, close and test lift. Right approaches white pen from above with closing direction adjusted perpendicular to its length.
Lift retained left doll before transfer. White pen lies left of the right wrist center; correct laterally and descend open for a closer alignment check.
Carry last retained doll toward blue while easing yaw for reach. Move right pads left in wrist image, descend to white pen barrel, close and make a small test lift.
Place last doll over blue with a forward wrist tilt to preserve reach margin. Test-lift the white pen with closed right gripper before transporting.
Release last doll within blue and withdraw left. White pen retention is uncertain; return open right gripper to a deeper barrel grasp rather than transporting prematurely.
Right pads are now at table height around the centered white barrel; close, pause, and lift to verify retention. Withdraw left clear of blue basket and central workspace.
White pen is retained in the right fingers; carry toward red. Third doll fell out of blue, so reapproach it with left rather than counting that category complete.
Carry white pen fully above red before releasing. Descend left open gripper toward fallen doll and rotate pads across the torso; verify close-up alignment next.
Correct left grasp onto doll torso, close and test lift. Nudge white pen inward over red with a small forward tilt, release, and start withdrawing.
Pens are together in red. Lift left doll again and approach blue carefully; right withdraws toward the watches, keeping the central arms separated.
Keep doll closed and move well over blue with forward tilt, avoiding the front rim. Right descends above the black watch, making a small image-guided centering adjustment.
Move doll farther inward before opening over blue. Center black watch in right pad gap, lower around the band, and close for a small retention test.
Withdraw open left gripper clear of blue and allow dolls to settle. Test-lift black watch vertically with right gripper closed; retention remains to be verified visually.

Black watch slipped through the central loop. Reopen and offset toward its solid front housing, descending deeper for an edge grasp. Left clears the central approach and reorients for eventual transfer.
Stop descending at contact, close around the watch strap and lift gently. Left moves clear and restores downward alignment for receiving watches on the left side.
Black watch is retained by a strap edge. Carry it to the central handoff area without crossing arms, rotating the dangling loop toward the left; left waits clear.
Watch did not remain retained through rotation. Reapproach it from above with the new pad direction, aiming for a wider solid-side grasp and avoiding another assumed transfer.
Target the watch's visible solid display housing on the left of the loop, not its empty center. Close at shallow table contact and make a small vertical retention test.
Previous closure missed; watch remains on table below the wrist center. Reopen, move pads toward the near-side housing, and lower the grasp height before closing.
The watch housing is now visibly between the pads. Lift gently with no wrist rotation, then begin a short translation toward the central transfer area while checking retention.
The band remains on the table. Reposition slightly onto the visible display edge rather than the loop, lower open pads to the housing, then close without transporting.

Move the contacted watch slowly toward the central transfer zone at low height without rotation; retention is still uncertain. Left approaches from its own side, leaving separation from the right gripper.
Watch stayed on the table, now clearly right of the wrist center. Recenter using the observed image displacement, moving right and toward the robot while open; avoid premature closure.
Open fingers pushed the watch during lateral correction. Lift clear before recentering over its new position; do not sweep laterally at contact height.
Watch is stationary and visible after clearance lift. Align specifically over the solid display on the left edge of its loop, then descend vertically with no lateral sweeping.
Watch is now inside the open pad envelope. Close in place at the current low height, pause for contact, and test only a one-centimeter lift.
The ring was pushed out during closure. Lift clear, shift to its new near-side position, and descend open for a deeper enclosure instead of closing against the outer edge.
The display is below the pad envelope. Lift briefly and shift onto the near-side solid housing, then descend and close in place without sweeping the watch.
The housing is enclosed between the pads. Maintain closure and lift without rotating; begin a slow inward translation only after vertical clearance.
Watch remains fixed in the right fingers after lifting. Translate without rotation to the shared center for a table handoff; left waits on its own side with pads aligned similarly.
Set retained watch down at the center for a sequential handoff, opening only near the table. Left backs away slightly to maintain wrist clearance; right begins withdrawing after release.
Right withdraws fully from the released watch. Left approaches from negative x only, with a slight inward tool tilt to reach the central handoff while keeping the arms uncrossed.
Left wrist shows the handed-off watch ahead of the pads; advance and lower from the left side. Right approaches above the untouched metal watch, with the wrists separated fore-aft.
Correct left pads toward the black housing using additional inward tool tilt while keeping the wrist on the left. Right centers above the metal watch and descends open for visual alignment.
Maintain left closure and lift slowly to test black-watch retention. Right adjusts onto the metal watch's near-side housing with a brief clearance lift, then closes at low height.
Left watch slipped back toward the right; withdraw left clear rather than continuing an off-center grasp. Hold right closed and test-lift the metal watch slowly to assess retention.

Metal watch housing is below the pad contact region; reopen, shift onto the housing with clearance, then descend deeper. Left approaches the empty white basket's front rim to bring it within shared reach, avoiding repeated failed handoffs.
Align left pads across the white basket front rim from above. Right lifts briefly to shift its grip onto the metal watch face, then closes without further descent against the table.
Close left pads around the basket front rim and test a tiny backward pull. Right lifts the metal watch without rotation to verify its housing grasp.
Metal watch remains visibly retained; hold it still. Left rim pinch missed, so reopen, center on the visible front wall and lower pads farther before closing again.
Pull the empty white basket by its pinched front rim toward the shared workspace, keeping left wrist on its side. Raise and move the retained metal watch aside to avoid the moving basket.
Basket did not follow the previous pull. Reopen and recenter farther inside its front rim at a lower height before retrying; keep the retained metal watch stationary and closed.
Left is at rim contact; stop forcing downward. Close in place, pause, then test a short gentle backward pull while keeping the metal watch secure.
Rim is still forward of the closed pads. Reopen, move three centimeters onto the wall, and lower enough for pads to straddle it; keep the retained metal watch motionless.
Front wall now lies between the open pads. Close on the rim, pause, then draw the basket backward with a slight lift and inward shift to test whether it follows.
White basket is not following, so stop pulling it. Clear left arm; bring retained metal watch to a better central handoff, tilting the tool left while keeping the right wrist in its workspace.
Set the metal watch down near the left-accessible side of center, keeping right wrist positive x. Left remains clear and rotates to match the successful housing-grasp direction.
Withdraw right upward from the released metal watch before separating toward the black watch. Left advances only to its own side of center, completing pad alignment for the next pickup.
Metal watch is now settled at center-left. Approach it with left pads while keeping wrist negative x. Right restores its previously useful near-down orientation and lowers above the black watch.
Use close wrist views to align the metal housing ahead of left pads with a small inward tilt, keeping wrist negative x. Recenter right pads on the black display and close at low height.
Close left pads around the centered metal housing. Separate the wrists by withdrawing right up and outward with the black-watch grip closed; lift left only after that clearance.
Metal watch is retained by left pads; lift and carry toward white without rotating it. Black watch is still on the table, so right reopens and recenters above its housing with clearance.
Carry retained metal watch over white with a modest forward tilt and reach margin. Right housing is centered; lower slightly, close, pause, and make a small test lift.

Advance metal watch fully inside white and release near the basket floor. Black display is below right pads after closure; lift clear, move toward that housing, and descend open rather than dragging it.
Metal watch is released inside white. Withdraw left clear. Black watch has rotated into the right pad envelope; close after a small descent and perform a short vertical retention test.

Black housing appears secured between pads. Lift vertically, then begin a gentle centerward translation without wrist rotation. Left prepares on its own side for the same sequential handoff used for the metal watch.
Black watch remains retained. Bring it to the center-left handoff by modest tool tilt while keeping right wrist positive x; left stays clear until it is set down.
